      <h3>Authoritarian Institutions and Regime Durability</h3>
      <p>
        Legislatures, parties, and elections in autocracies are often dismissed as window dressing.
        I study what elites actually do inside them: how loyalty is performed, when criticism is
        tolerated, and how these institutions absorb pressure and adapt as regimes face war,
        sanctions, and questions of succession.

<style>
.triptych {
  --tp-head: #1c1c1a;
  --tp-body: #5c5b57;
  --tp-rule: #e2e0da;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 3rem auto;
  padding: 0 1rem;
  font-family: Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
}
.tcard {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2rem;
  padding: 1.9rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--tp-rule);
}
.tcard:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--tp-rule); }
.tmark {
  flex: 0 0 168px;
}
.tmark svg {
  display: block;
  width: 168px;
  height: auto;
}
.tbody { flex: 1; }
.tcard h3 {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
  letter-spacing: .002em;
  color: var(--tp-head);
  margin: 0 0 .55rem;
}
.tcard p {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: .875rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: var(--tp-body);
  margin: 0;
}
.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(14px);
  transition: opacity .75s ease, transform .75s ease;
}
.reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.tcard:nth-child(2).reveal { transition-delay: .1s; }
.tcard:nth-child(3).reveal { transition-delay: .2s; }
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .tcard { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; }
  .tmark { flex: none; }
  .tmark svg { width: 150px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
  .triptych svg animate { display: none; }
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.triptych .reveal');
  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window) ||
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    cards.forEach(function (c) { c.classList.add('visible'); });
    return;
  }
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (e) {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('visible');
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.2 });
  cards.forEach(function (c) { io.observe(c); });
})();
</script>
